scope: Read-only source audit; no production/SDK changes and no timing measurement.

findings.item: One application transmit API per fragment
findings.evidence: SendFragment formats into persistent scratch, copies chunk, invokes SendGattValue once. There is no esp_ble_gatts_set_attr_value call anywhere in the component. No duplicate application TX enqueue was found.

Success path formats memory with snprintf and updates counters. printf sites cover boot, non-ASCII/corruption and RX errors. GATT/BTC/APPL SDK trace levels are WARNING2; normal API/debug traces are disabled in current config.

TX attributes are ESP_GATT_AUTO_RSP, READ/NOTIFY/INDICATE; initial s_emptyValue is ONE zero byte. GATTS_HandleValueNotification builds ATT output from its input without updating attribute storage. Read is therefore not a latest-frame or terminal-recovery mechanism. Do not add per-fragment set_attr_value as a supposed fix.

findings.item: SDK asynchronous CONF event also occurs for FAST notifications
findings.evidence: bta_gatts_indicate_handle invokes CONF when status is not success OR need_confirm is false. btc_gatts_inter_cb posts a callback message back to BTC. This is local SDK completion/status, not a second wire transmit nor peer ATT confirmation.

findings.item: Successful CONF payload has two avoidable SDK copies
findings.evidence: bta_gatts_send_conf_evt_to_app allocates/copies the payload, and btc_gatts_cb_param_copy_req allocates/copies it again for queued callback lifetime. btc_gatts_cb_handler only exposes conf.value/len when status!=ESP_GATT_OK; successful callbacks set len0. A SDK-local optimization could pass no payload on successful status while preserving the event, conn/handle/status, and full error payload/lifetime. Current authorization excludes edits to that SDK repository; no patch applied.

btc_transfer_context allocates message and deep-copies TX payload; BTA_GATTS_HandleValueIndication allocates/copies indication object; GATTS_HandleValueNotification copies to a stack value and ATT builder allocates packet storage. Calling internal BTC/BTA APIs to bypass these would change ownership/ABI and is not a minimal application fix.

findings.item: FAST asynchronous failure is currently unobserved
findings.evidence: Application ESP_GATTS_CONF_EVT branch only handles confirmPending. FAST no-pending callbacks, including status!=OK, do not increment a status error counter. BLESVC accepted/fe0 therefore do not exclude later BTA/L2CAP local rejection. A future bounded aggregate OK/error observation can preserve events without per-notification logging; connId reuse means generation attribution must remain unknown where unproven.

PlanFragments probes count1,2,... using snprintf header-length trials. A three-fragment record normally formats five trial headers plus three real headers. Exact digit-length calculation could remove only trial snprintf calls while retaining actual wire formatter, CRC, ASCII checks, MTU limits and equalized chunks; equivalence tests across all lengths/MTU/message-ID digit boundaries are required. No CPU-saving magnitude is measured, and this cannot be called the35FPS root cause.

recommendation: First collect actual scheduled runtime and controller credit observations. Preserve scientific/error/control semantics. The successful-CONF-copy issue is a concrete SDK optimization candidate, but current source-only evidence cannot allocate the4.8ms API wall time to heap, BT tasks or peer scheduling.
